title: Exact-schema bounded batches through the original CPython C JSON encoder

baseline.evidence_boundary: Historical bounded receipt reads only; no candidate measurements and no independent reconstruction in this lane

primary_sources.runtime_boundary: Upstream source explains mechanism; it is not attestation of the distro's compiled _json binary. Parent must bind/authenticate actual runtime dependencies before execution.

source_research_failure.command: bounded curl download of CPython release source to lane reference directory
source_research_failure.stderr: curl: (6) Could not resolve host: raw.githubusercontent.com
source_research_failure.resolution: No command retry; used read-only web primary source plus exact release commit. No fetched source bytes or source hash claimed.

domain.primary: Frozen exact witness schema, exact builtin containers/scalars, no cycles, depth <=32, bounded per-record encoded upper bound
domain.integer_policy: No fixed-word integer restriction; original Python decimal conversion and int max-str-digits behavior retained
domain.fallback: Before IO, invoke separately retained untouched original write_scientific with original arguments for any unadmitted domain
domain.bounded_memory_scope: Admitted path only; original fallback can retain original full allocations
domain.concurrency: Source-checked frozen single-thread caller; arbitrary concurrent mutation is outside admitted domain

batching.implementation: Exact list batches encoded by ordinary json.dumps C path; only outer array brackets omitted via memoryview and commas inserted between batches

estimators.containers: sum recursive child bounds plus punctuation

interfaces.rank: Exact builtin list remains unchanged; rows may be interned immutable exact tuples; no new interface
interfaces.reference: Separate original module/function/process; never rebind original writer or canonical encoder
interfaces.integration: Parent selects candidate writer at existing side serialization phase; eager witness construction initially unchanged
interfaces.observations: Return original receipt only; separate bounded operational receipt preserves scientific stdout/schema

output_contract.acceptance: Compute original rank counts and entire EXPECTED comparison after all three staged encodings, before any final file changes
output_contract.publication: Bounded copy into original wb final sinks, preserving completed files and failing prefix; no atomic rename
output_contract.failure_evidence: Retain private partial stage and bounded failure manifest; retain any visible partial final; cleanup errors cannot mask original error
output_contract.success_cleanup: Remove only this call's private stage after all final writes close successfully
declared_differences: Different final syscall grouping and possibly different OS failure prefix length
Short-write behavior must receive explicit source-review disposition before implementation
